description_en: Queries the products and logs integrated with Threat Analysis for the entire enterprise or regular members, along with the data delivery status of these logs
description_zh: 查看整个企业或者普通成员接入威胁分析的产品、日志列表，以及这些日志的数据投递情况
name: ListDelivery

parameters.help_en:
The view type. Valid values:
0: The view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.
1: The view of all accounts in the enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

0：当前阿里云账号视图。
1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user whose perspective the administrator switches to
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The region of the data management center for Threat Analysis. Select the region of the management center based on the region of your assets. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: Select this value if your assets are in the Chinese mainland and Hong Kong (China).
ap-southeast-1: Select this value if your assets are outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港，选择该项。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域，选择该项
parameters.name: region_id

DisplaySwitchOrNot.description_en:

true: Display the delivery switch.
false: Hide the delivery switch
